encoding.palette: Shared 256 colors; Pillow median-cut palette from ten evenly spaced frames; no dithering
encoding.duplicateFrames: Combined by GIF encoder; durations preserved

omissions: Startup, profile switch, narrow-window check and application restart are omitted between excerpts. Full source videos retain them. No pixels cropped, masked or recolored; no invented motion.

decode.command: ffmpeg -ss START -i SOURCE -t DURATION -r 8 -vf scale=1120:-1 clip-%03d.png
decode.note: End is the requested cutoff; decoding stops at EOF if earlier. Samples stay in order. No speed change.
decode.frameDelaysMs: Alternate 120 and 130, starting with 120. Identical frames combine with summed duration.
